newsitem.title: USA: Sour crudes gain strength in U.S., outrights firm.
newsitem.headline: Sour crudes gain strength in U.S., outrights firm.

text.p: U.S. cash crude markets firmed Monday, led higher for cash grades by sour barrel sales against a rallying outright price.

Futures markets advanced on tensions between Iran and the West, notably potential troubles for the Islamic regime concerning ties to the bombing of the American barracks in Saudi Arabia last year. A Washington Post report on Sunday said Saudi and U.S. intelligence has linked the bombing to an Iranian government official.
Separately, outright prices found support from technical buying as a result of last week's bounce from recent lows.
